column3: The Hebrew describes his bones as terrified; BSB says in agony.
The Hebrew has how long once and explicitly says and You; BSB repeats how long.
The Hebrew pictures making his bed swim and melting his couch; BSB says flood and drench.
The Hebrew has eye in the singular and says it grew old; BSB has eyes growing dim.
The Hebrew explicitly names the voice of his weeping.
The Hebrew presents accepting the prayer as future; BSB uses accepts.
The Hebrew repeats being ashamed and explicitly says greatly dismayed.
